name: Dominion grants Armor when Soul Infusion is gained (#1339)
contract: Dominion 803999 promises: 'Gaining Soul Infusion now increases your Armor by 585 for 6 sec.'
Spell.dbc's own ProcFlags (4, DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK) do not match this event: gaining Soul
Infusion is not a native combat proc, it is AscensionCompat.cpp's SynchronizeThresholdResources
casting 803031 once the Reaper's Reaped Soul stacks reach 3, the same event
ApplyAscensionReaperSoulInfusionGained already answers for Damned and Purgatory. Dominion's own
trigger spell 804000 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE, MiscValue 1 Physical/Armor) is added to that
same function, matching the pattern used for the other two Soul-Infusion-gain talents.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Reaching 3 Reaped Souls grants Soul Infusion
Dominion applies its Armor buff at the same time
